output.reason: The brief backs its master-data diagnosis with specific evidence: no overrides on any of the 47 jobs, every job correct before 4 Oct, wrong jobs on Line 1 day shift run by permanent staff, and a future-dated 36-month entry. That evidence rules out the operator theory and leads to clear containment steps, but the brief can't yet explain why PackBridge used the future-dated value, and its second-person check at setup wouldn't catch this fault because operators verify against a work order that comes from the same PackBridge data.
